context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 53 verified all NEW backup CRUD endpoints and provisioning QR code generation. Backup API flow: create -> list -> get -> restore -> delete all working. Provisioning QR code generates valid Android Device Owner enrollment payload with optional WiFi config. Device Owner mode APIs (from iteration 52) still functioning correctly. Frontend is React Native Expo app - cannot be tested via browser.

backup_create.evidence: POST /api/backup/create returns {backup_id, created_at, stats: {clients, loans, payments, loan_history}, size_bytes}

backup_list.evidence: GET /api/backup/list returns {backups: [{backup_id, created_at, stats, size_bytes, google_email}]}

backup_get.evidence: GET /api/backup/{id} returns full backup with {backup_id, created_at, stats, data: {clients, loans, payments, loan_history}}

backup_restore.evidence: POST /api/backup/restore/{id} returns {message, restored: {clients, loans, payments, loan_history}}

backup_delete.evidence: DELETE /api/backup/{id} returns {message: 'Backup deleted'} and subsequent GET returns 404

provisioning_qr_basic.evidence: GET /api/provisioning/qr-code returns {qr_code_base64, provisioning_data with PROVISIONING_DEVICE_ADMIN_COMPONENT_NAME, instructions}

provisioning_qr_with_wifi.evidence: GET /api/provisioning/qr-code?wifi_ssid=X&wifi_password=Y includes PROVISIONING_WIFI_SSID, PROVISIONING_WIFI_PASSWORD, PROVISIONING_WIFI_SECURITY_TYPE in payload

register_9_digit_device_owner.evidence: POST /api/device/register with 9-char code sets lock_mode='device_owner' in response

register_8_digit_device_admin.evidence: POST /api/device/register with 8-char code sets lock_mode='device_admin' in response
